text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Kikuka Sho has finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text: “—Now, it is time for music.”

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Is that the Sounds of Earth thing?
The musical commentary she often puts out before races.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I figured I'd check it one more time before it starts~
I mean, if you really know the girls who are running,
it makes cheering for them in the race way more exciting!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
――Earth's final workout was pretty solid.
Looks like she'll put in a great run following the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"I hope her rhythm doesn't get disrupted.
If Earth can stay relaxed until the midway point,
she definitely has a shot at winning...!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text: ...Just how many Earth videos did you watch?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I'm in great shape.
I can hear the sounds of the world so clearly.
choice_data_list: Looks like the crowd's going to be fired up again today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Showing her the massive response to the video she posted,
as well as footage capturing the race fans gathered at the venue—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! Everyone seems so thrilled today as well...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...It really makes me think again.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: While I love performing the music known as racing—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Just as much as that,
she loved entertaining people with music.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The more people love the races and cheer for us, the more strength we Umamusume can pour into our running, giving birth to even more magnificent races—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This glorious cycle...
is like a symphony in itself...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—I want to enjoy myself.
...And I want to entertain everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
More of this music...!
Together with so many more people...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, today!
In this final race of the Classic Triple Crown!!
I will perform the culmination of our entire generation!!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And let us stir up a whole new frenzy!
With that passion, let's carry it into our journey toward the next ultimate music!
choice_data_list: I'll be in the front row enjoying your performance again today!
I'll be in the front row enjoying your performance again today!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, savor it to your heart's content!!
Our music!!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: In the end... I ended up coming to watch.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of Kikuka Sho it'll turn out to be today—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Now, ladies and gentlemen in the audience!!
Please, enjoy our session to your heart's content again today!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: You really know how to liven up a crowd, as always.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufuâ
Because that is my music.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: Let's make today a great race, Earth-kun!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, let it ring out with all our might!!
An ensemble that only we can create!!"
